requirements.name: Passport category: ECR vs ECNR
requirements.description: Indian passports are either ECR (Emigration Check Required, endorsed) or ECNR. Only ECR passport holders going for employment to an ECR country need Emigration Clearance. Most graduate software engineers hold ECNR passports (ECNR eligibility rules, e.g. by education level, not re-verified this session). App should ask the user's passport category once and only show EC steps for ECR holders.

requirements.name: Emigration Clearance (EC) via eMigrate - ECR passport holders only
requirements.description: ECR passport holders need EC from a Protector of Emigrants (16 PoE offices) before going to any of the 19 ECR countries for employment, under the Emigration Act 1983. Processed through eMigrate (launched 2015), integrated with Passport Seva and Bureau of Immigration checks at airports. Foreign employers must register on eMigrate before recruiting from India. EC for Libya and Yemen currently suspended.

requirements.name: eMigrate registration for ECNR holders (voluntary)
requirements.description: ECNR holders going to ECR countries for employment may register voluntarily on eMigrate and avail PBBY insurance. A 2018 advisory making it mandatory from 2019-01-01 was put in abeyance. App: show as 'recommended, optional'.

requirements.name: Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) insurance
requirements.description: Mandatory for ECR workers going to ECR countries; optional for ECNR via voluntary eMigrate registration. Cover INR 10 lakh for accidental death/permanent disability plus hospitalisation (INR 1,00,000), repatriation, legal expenses (INR 45,000), etc.

requirements.name: Use only eMigrate-registered Recruiting Agents (RA)
requirements.description: No person may act as a Recruiting Agent without a certificate from the PGE (Emigration Act 1983, s.10). Verify the RA licence number on eMigrate's 'List of active RA'. 3,505 illegal agents notified on eMigrate as of 2026-04-09. MEA advisory (Dec 2023) states RA service charge capped at Rs 30,000 + 18% GST. Direct-hire tech jobs usually involve no RA at all - any agent asking for money is a red flag.

typical_cost.note: legal maximum RA service charge, plus 18% GST; per MEA advisory as reported - not a fee the user must pay

requirements.name: Apostille of documents by MEA (Hague Apostille Convention countries)
requirements.description: India is party to the Apostille Convention (in force for India 2005-07-14). For Convention countries, MEA apostille replaces embassy legalisation. Process: issuing authority / state verification (educational docs: state education dept or university; personal docs: state home/GAD) -> MEA apostille via MEA-authorised outsourced collection agencies or e-Sanad (for digitally available docs). Notable recent joiners: Saudi Arabia (2022-12-07), China (2023-11-07), Canada (2024-01-11). Thailand deposited accession 2026-06-30, effective 2027-02-28 - until then use attestation. Many destinations (e.g. DE, NL) often do not require apostille for a work visa at all; check the destination country file.

typical_cost.note: MEA apostille fee per document (search snippet of MEA page). Outsourced agency charge reported as Rs 84 service + Rs 3/page scanning; e-Sanad ~Rs 90/doc (secondary). Plus university/state verification fees (vary).

requirements.name: MEA attestation + embassy legalisation (non-Apostille countries)
requirements.description: For countries not party to the Apostille Convention (of Shorebound destinations: UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Malaysia; Thailand until 2027-02-28), documents follow: state/issuing-authority verification -> MEA attestation (normal attestation is free at MEA) -> attestation by destination country's embassy/consulate in India -> often destination foreign ministry (e.g. UAE MOFA) after arrival. Gulf work-permit processing commonly requires attested degree certificates.

requirements.name: Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) via Passport Seva
requirements.description: Apply on Passport Seva portal (register -> 'Apply for Police Clearance Certificate'), book PSK/POPSK appointment. Many work visas (e.g. Gulf, Canada PR, Australia, NZ) require it; check the destination file. Applicants already abroad apply via Indian Mission (e.g. VFS/consulate).

typical_cost.note: Passport Seva FAQ snippet; processing time depends on police verification (secondary estimates ~1-4 weeks; not official).

requirements.name: Pending law: Overseas Mobility (Facilitation and Welfare) Bill, 2025
requirements.description: Draft bill to replace the Emigration Act 1983: Overseas Mobility and Welfare Council, regulation of recruitment agencies with penalties, measures against irregular emigration and trafficking, mobility resource centres. Public comments closed 2025-11-07. As of 2026-11-22 no evidence found that it was introduced or passed; Emigration Act 1983 still governs. Re-check at review.

requirements.name: Tax residency when leaving India (NRI basics)
requirements.description: An Indian citizen leaving India in a financial year for employment abroad is resident only if in India >= 182 days that year (the general 60-day limb does not apply). Otherwise NRI: only India-sourced income taxable in India. Deemed-residence / RNOR rules can apply to citizens with Indian income > Rs 15 lakh (120-day limb; deemed resident if not liable to tax elsewhere). Leaving mid-year: year of departure often still 'resident' if >= 182 days already spent. Keep travel dates; check DTAA and foreign tax credit; convert savings accounts to NRO/NRE (FEMA). Not tax advice.

scam_advisories.issuer: Ministry of External Affairs (via PIB) / Indian Missions
scam_advisories.summary: Rise in job seekers cheated by unregistered agents and overcharged Rs 2-5 lakh; fake offers targeting Canada, Israel, Europe. Red flags: WhatsApp-only communication, no contract signed by foreign employer/RA/emigrant, tourist visa instead of work visa. Verify RA licence on emigrate.gov.in 'List of active RA'. RA charge cap Rs 30,000 + GST. Contacts: pge@mea.gov.in, helpline@mea.gov.in.
Fake IT/'digital marketing' jobs in Thailand used to take Indians illegally into Myanmar; verify foreign employers through Indian Missions and check recruiting agents' antecedents.

scam_advisories.issuer: Ministry of External Affairs / Embassies of India in Cambodia and Laos
scam_advisories.summary: Fake agents (with counterparts in India) lure people to Cambodia/Laos (often via Thailand) for 'Digital Sales and Marketing Executive' or 'Customer Support' roles at cyber-scam companies. Use only MEA-approved agents.
6,998 Indian nationals rescued from cybercrime centres in Cambodia, Myanmar and Laos 2022-2025; lures mostly via social media. Airports display warning posters.

24x7 toll-free 1800 11 3090; overseas (chargeable) +91-11-26885021; WhatsApp +91 74283 21144; email helpline@mea.gov.in; X @helplinePBSK; 11 languages. Grievances can also be logged on eMigrate. Walk-in Kshetriya PSKs: Delhi, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Chennai, Patna, Kochi.
Online consular grievance portal for Indians abroad (and families) - URL not re-verified this session.
